entities.summary: Heinz Zednik is an Austrian operatic buffo tenor, closely associated with the character tenor roles of Wagner such as Mime and Loge and David. He is also distinguished in roles such as Valzacchi, Monostatos, Pedrillo, the Scribe (Khovanshchina), the Captain in Wozzeck, and the Director. Heinz Zednik was a composers & musicians from Vienna (b. 1940-02-21, Vienna). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
